scripts.build: tsc -p ui && vite build ui && cargo build --workspace
scripts.test: npm run test:checks && npm run test:rust && npm run test:ui && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:checks: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-licences.mjs && node scripts/check-layers.mjs && node scripts/check-names.mjs
scripts.test:ui: tsc -p ui && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings -c ui/.oxlintrc.json ui/src && node --test ui/src/*.test.mjs
